{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check the number of NaNs
total_rows = len(df)
invalid_rows = df['revenue_clean'].isna().sum()

print(f'Total rows: {total_rows}')
print(f'Invalid revenue rows: {invalid_rows}')

# Show the invalid revenue values
invalid_values = df[df['revenue_clean'].isna()]['revenue'].unique()
print('\nInvalid revenue values:')
print(invalid_values)"}
